text: Introduction The Law program will provide the students with basic legal theory at home and abroad, basic training of legal thinking and reasoning, interpersonal communication, legal analysis and solving legal problems ability, the ability to deal with legal affairs, good legal culture of oral expression and written expression skills, social development and adaptation ability. Courses in pretrial skills, client counseling, negotiations, trial practice, and alternative dispute resolution are an established part of the curriculum, which train students to be both legal scholars and also legal professionals.Main courses Jurisprudence, Constitutional Law, Civil Law, Administrative Law, Criminal Law, International Law, International Trade Law, Civil Procedure Law, Criminal Procedure Law, Traffic Law, Administrative LawFee 20000 RMB per yearDuration 4 yearsDegree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Law by Ningbo University.
